sql: SELECT b.period_start, b.period_end, b.days, CAST(b.kwh AS DOUBLE) AS kwh, count(CAST(w.TMAX AS DOUBLE) + CAST(w.TMIN AS DOUBLE)) AS weather_days, coalesce(round(sum(greatest((CAST(w.TMAX AS DOUBLE) + CAST(w.TMIN AS DOUBLE)) / 2 - 65, 0)), 1), 0) AS cdd, coalesce(round(sum(greatest(65 - (CAST(w.TMAX AS DOUBLE) + CAST(w.TMIN AS DOUBLE)) / 2, 0)), 1), 0) AS hdd FROM (VALUES (DATE '2025-11-13', DATE '2025-12-14', 31, 1014), (DATE '2025-12-14', DATE '2026-01-13', 30, 1070), (DATE '2026-01-13', DATE '2026-02-13', 31, 1222), (DATE '2026-02-13', DATE '2026-03-15', 30, 992), (DATE '2026-03-15', DATE '2026-04-15', 31, 900), (DATE '2026-04-15', DATE '2026-05-15', 30, 872), (DATE '2026-05-15', DATE '2026-06-15', 31, 1076), (DATE '2026-06-15', DATE '2026-07-15', 30, 1457), (DATE '2026-07-15', DATE '2026-08-14', 30, 1379), (DATE '2026-08-14', DATE '2026-09-15', 32, 1717)) AS b(period_start, period_end, days, kwh) LEFT JOIN noaa_ncei.cmh_daily_from_2024 w ON to_date(w.DATE) >= b.period_start AND to_date(w.DATE) < b.period_end GROUP BY b.period_start, b.period_end, b.days, b.kwh ORDER BY b.period_start
